## What happened

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Where

- File: `path/to/file.md` or `path/to/example.json`
- Section: The heading or section in the file
- Line (if known): The line number

## What I expected

What you expected to see.

## What I saw

What you actually saw. Include a screenshot if relevant.

## How to reproduce

Steps to reproduce the bug, if applicable.

## Suggested fix

If you have a suggestion for how to fix the bug, describe it.

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant (browser, OS, version of the project, etc.).
